title: ADL 234762
concept: DNR has preliminarily proposed giving about 19,950 acres near Houston to AIDEA with no payment for land value. AIDEA's plan lists data centers as a possible use, and AIDEA's own director wrote that no tenant, site plan, power, cooling, water plan or schedule exists. The film draws the case file as Folio, a manila folder with a face that goes thin, fat and hollow, whose six index tabs are the six missing things. It gives the best case for the transfer a full warm scene (site control before a tenant signs, ready land, AIDEA's own dividend claim), shows why that case is real but doesn't answer this land, and ends on the one date, October 26th, when senators can first ask the commissioner.

fingerprint.light_story: flat overcast celadon window light on a walnut desk until one banker lamp clicks on at the end, overcast snow light on the Houston flat, a spruce-green hearing room, a bright counter
fingerprint.metaphor: a manila case folder with six empty tabs asked to hold a forest

palette: overcast celadon and slate over birch-bone snow, walnut and banker green land office, manila folder, fireweed magenta for what is missing
divergence_note: 10-18 was a blue-hour indigo to rose world with a mustard felt bench and a mint jelly. 10-17 a low peach sun with banknote green. This film is overcast celadon and slate with a walnut land-office desk, a manila folder hero and fireweed magenta, moving through a desk, a plan sheet, a blotter macro, a dotted plan, a letter, a snowy council flat, a hearing room, a counter and a shelf.

treatment.winner: The Comedian's Folder (ADL 234762, six empty tabs, an empty chair gag), with the Dramatist's key-shop tenant headlights as the counter scene, the Explainer's acres plan sheet and the Enthusiast's fair land-bank counter.
treatment.why: A face on a hard-cornered object carries emotion, six tabs make the six missing things countable and the best case gets a warm scene before the film asks its question.

angle.thesis: Alaska is being asked to decide whether about 19,950 acres of public land should pass to AIDEA with no payment for land value before anyone can say what will be built there, and October 26th is the first time senators can put that question to the department making the call.
angle.falsifiable_by: Before or at the October 26th hearing AIDEA or DNR puts forward any of the six things Ruaro's July 30th letter says do not exist yet (committed tenant, site plan, power source, cooling, water plan, construction schedule), or the commissioner treats the preliminary finding as settled.
supporting_facts: c2 no payment for land value, AIDEA still pays survey and closing
c4+c5 data centers only a possible use, and the applicant's own letter lists six things that do not exist
c6 the director called a data center on the site implausible (per Alaska Public Media), so the fear and the plan both point at an empty record
c7+c10 the Legislature subpoenaed the commissioner after DNR said the governor's office had not given permission
angle.counterpoint_honored: AIDEA's case at full strength: a development authority needs site control before any tenant commits, ready land is how a state competes, AIDEA says about $495 million in dividends declared to the state, the finding is preliminary and the process (comment, subpoena, hearing) is doing its job. The thesis never says the transfer is wrong.
angle.second_movement: The word implausible (c6) cuts both ways: the data center is not the real question, the empty record is. The $495M is statewide, self-reported and ties to no land here (c12 note).
angle.ai_hook: No source mentions AI. Data centers are the buildings AI runs in, said once as context. The film says data centers, never AI data centers.

runner_ups.enthusiast land-bank: folded in as the counterpoint scene
runner_ups.resident skeptic: folded in as c13 respect beat; thesis too close to opposition framing
